issues.description: Lesson 27 "امیرانِ اندلس" is a two-page list (pp.132–133) rendered as structured tables. On p.133 the printed dates sit between rows; they are assigned to the nearest row as printed, and rows with no printed date are left blank (Abd al-Malik bin Balj, Abu al-Khattab, Tha'bah, Abd al-Rahman bin Hisham, Muhammad bin Abd al-Rahman). Printed names and dates kept as printed (e.g. "عتبہ بن حجاج", "بلخ بن بشر", "سمع بن مالک فولانی", "عنبسہ بن شحیم", "المنذر ۸۷۶ء تا ۸۷۸ء", "عبدالرحمان ناصر ۹۰۳ء تا ۹۵۳ء"); Pashto gives standard spellings for the first two. Student ticks on p.132 excluded.
